record.question: What is the normal range of reticulocytes in adults?
record.explanation: Official final key: C — 0.5%-2.5%. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 7, printed Q42. Source limitation: MedlinePlus notes reference ranges vary, while RCPA directs readers to the local laboratory interval; offered ranges overlap plausible intervals. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
